text:
Predicates:
Stable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
Stable(diamondMine) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable.
Leads(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers.
Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes Ivy Nile.
Feud(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Stable(x) ∧ Includes(x, ivyNile) ∧ Feud(imperium, x)) ::: Imperium doesn't have a feud with a professional wrestling stable that includes Ivy Nile.
